fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Push — это приложение на телефоне человека, а external_id — адрес устройства от Firebase. У одного человека их столько, сколько устройств: телефон в цехе и телефон дома — две записи.
The channel's own identifier — a Telegram user id or a phone number in international format. Matched exactly; never by name.
fields.label: External ID

fields.description: What the channel calls them. Shown to an administrator deciding who this is; never used to match.
fields.label: Display Name

fields.description: The KORKEM user this channel identity speaks as. Every tool in the turn runs with exactly this person's permissions and company.
fields.label: User
Role
fields.description: Optional. Narrows what this identity may reach on this channel; it can never widen what the user's own roles already allow.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Which way to reach this person first when they are on more than one channel. Lower is tried first; equal priorities fall back to Telegram, then WhatsApp, then whichever was heard from most recently.
